style.why: The hook (scoring on debut then a three-year gap) is memorable and creates good tension. The teammate list effectively narrows the field to Newcastle's recent squad. It loses one point because 'Isak' is a very strong giveaway for a Newcastle fan, making it slightly easier than intended for a keen UK
style.fix: Consider swapping Isak for a less obvious teammate from his time at Bournemouth or Norwich to increase difficulty and fit the 'surprise name' style better.
